title: Frame allocation bound
statement: For every program $P$ and limits record $	ext{lim}$, the main frame size plus the frame size of $P$ plus one is at most the number of stack cells allocated for $P$ under $	ext{lim}$: $4 + 	ext{frameSize}(P) + 1 \le 4 + (\text{frameSize}(P)+1)(\text{lim.depth}+1)$.
